description: Department of Lab our - The Cost of Living for the Cocoa, Cardmom and Pepper Growing and Manufectaring Trade.
categorisation: This gazette notification announces a special allowance for workers in specific trades under the Wages Boards Ordinance. It cites legal authority (Section 20(2)(b) of the Wages Boards Ordinance) and establishes regulatory compliance requirements for wage payments. The content focuses on implementing a legal/regulatory framework rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
